title: Emulating Retrieval Augmented Generation via Prompt Engineering for Enhanced Long Context Comprehension in LLMs
authors: Joon Park; Kyohei Atarashi; Koh Takeuchi; Hisashi Kashima
why_relevant: Proposes prompt-based emulation of RAG to handle distractor-heavy long contexts (BABILong), touching on distraction robustness in long-context settings.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is long-context comprehension via prompt engineering, not robustness of RAG to unreliable evidence; limited direct contribution to survey themes.
